question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to make the whole story. Only the corresponding
stimulus: numbers of the sentences need to be written. 1  8 = 8 (a) He is considered the greatest physicist after Einstein. (b) He is very skilled in Mathematics from an early age and having a brilliant result, he was able to join Cambridge University as a Lucasian professor of Mathematics. (c) In it the explains Cosmology for the general public. (d) He got married in 1963. (e) He became famous and established his reputation as a great scientist. (f) He got his Ph. D in cosmology from Cambridge University by the time he was 26 years old. (g) Stephen Hawking was born in an educated family. (h) He wrote a book, ‘A brief history of Time, From the Big Dang to the Present Times’. Part−B : Writing Test [50 Marks]
guide_solution: Rearranging 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 g b f d c e h a All of you have heard the name of Begum Rokeya. She was born in 1880 in the village Pairabond, Rangpur. She was married with Khan Bahadur Sakhawat Hossain in 1898. In 1902 she started her writing career. In 1908 she composed her famous writing named ‘Sultana’s Dream’ A tragic moment came to her life in 1909 when her husband died. After five months of her husband's death she established a school named Sakhawat Memorial Girls’ High School with five students. This famous woman breathed her last in 1932.
